aggregation: Equal-quarter arithmetic means, computed with scalar compensated summation. Paired differences are fallback minus own hold. LOO is descriptive sensitivity, not a new registered subset or confidence interval.
interpretation_limits: No fallback policy retains all observed regime mean signs across both cost settings.
Target1 can reduce or increase exposure; these results do not establish a universally safer or optimal fallback.
Perp_scaled tradeoff changes sign between folds5 and6; current diagnostics do not justify conditioning policy on future quarter returns or dropping quarters.
LOO cannot remove selection uncertainty, serial dependence, regime undercoverage, or common-mask and archive-receipt limits.
Existing trace episodes document state and subsequent re-entry; they are not an additive attribution of economic differences.
scope: Post-outcome descriptive scalar reaggregation of all seven registered target1 fallback policies versus their own hold controls. All eight one-quarter omissions are reported; none is selected or removed from primary results. No new model, forecast, policy, rollout, or uncertainty test.
units: AlphaEx and MaxDD differences in percentage points; fees and borrowing in percentage points of initial equity; other fields explicitly named.
